newsitem.title: UK: Granada clinches 59 pct of Yorkshire.
newsitem.headline: Granada clinches 59 pct of Yorkshire.

text.p: British hotels and media company Granada Group Plc on Wednesday took control of its neighbour, Yorkshire-Tyne Tees Television Holdings Plc, after its 680 million stg bid was declared partly unconditional.
Granada said it had received acceptances for 59.1 percent of Yorkshire's issued share capital and said the offer for shares would remain open until further notice.

Some Yorkshire institutional investors have opposed the takeover, demanding a higher price. Yorkshire's chairman Ward Thomas, who agreed to the bid while on holiday in the south of France, said Mercury Asset Management had been the most vocal of opponents.
But with no counter-bidder emerging, MAM's hopes of winning more money for its stake appear to have been dashed.
